svg.title: Tray label dieline — royal
svg.text: Corner radius 5 mm (0.2 in). Roll label, permanent adhesive on board lid; matte or soft-touch stock takes ballpoint.
Zone band colour swaps per district; everything else stays put. Lid itself is not die-cut here.
